thread:
Alex S: Quick sync — just closed contract with HelixHealth (Midsize). 6-mo commitment starting Apr 1. Selling notes: high-priority for SSO, VPC peering, and low-latency inference for clinical UI. Renewal flagged at 6 months; exec sponsor unknown.
Jordan (CS): Congrats! I can take lead on onboarding. Need full access to their API keys + deployment contact. Any red flags on billing/PO?
Alex S: PO coming through legal, but finance said they'll delay invoicing until they confirm compliance docs. Risk: procurement may push go-live if SSO/HIPAA docs lag.
Priya C: I'll own compliance checklist. Can someone drop precise scope for Private deployment vs hosted? We need to know if they're choosing Private right away.
Alex S: Sales discussed Private (VPC) initially but left option open for hosted trial. They want Private if perf meets SLA. Contact: Dr. Lina Park (IT) lina.park@helixhealth.com, and infra lead: Marco (marco@helix). 
Jordan (CS): Thanks — adding Lina & Marco to onboarding invite. Action: Jordan to run discovery call with Lina next Wed. Owner: Jordan. ETA: 2026-04-01.
Marta (Support): If they go Private, we'll need eng help for network setup and KMS. What region/cloud are they targeting?
Evan (Eng): We'll need a few things: VPC CIDR, allowed IP ranges, and expected RPS. Also KMS provider (AWS KMS vs customer HSM) and certs. Send sample `vpc_peering.json` and we'll prep playbook.
Jordan (CS): I asked Marco for region; he said `us-west-2`. Expected peak ~20 rps, average 3 rps during biz hours. I'll capture Marco's answers in the onboarding doc.
OnboardBot: New onboarding doc created: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/helixhealth-2198765432
Priya C: Renewal risk note: their procurement timeline is tight. If SSO/KMS isn't validated by month 2, renewals are at risk. Recommend canary testing with hosted, then migrate to Private after perf validation. 
Alex S: Agreed. Can Jordan map a phased rollout? Phase 0: hosted sandbox (tracking metrics), Phase 1: private pilot, Phase 2: full cutover. 
Jordan (CS): I'll draft rollout plan and owners by EOD Friday. Owners: Jordan (onboarding lead), Priya (compliance), Evan (eng private deploy), Marta (support), Alex S (customer success sponsor from sales).
Evan (Eng): I'll assign an infra oncall for VPC peering and KMS — tagging @infra-oncall. ETA for config template: 3 business days after Marco provides CIDR.
Marta (Support): I'll prepare runbook for monitoring alerts and escalation path. Need sample queries for latency > 300ms, error rate > 1%.
Alex S: Also capture customer feedback loop — weekly cadence for first month, then bi-weekly. Jordan will own meeting invites.
Jordan (CS): Noted. I'll create folder and share prompts/checklists. Also collecting initial eval prompts they use (clinical triage) — that will inform quantization/latency needs.
Priya C: I'm tracking compliance docs; tagging legal for BAA review. If anyone collects docs, drop them into `secure/onboarding/helixhealth`.
Alex S: Great. Final ask: everyone please add a single-line status update to the thread by tomorrow so I can brief the AE and CFO.
Jordan (CS): Status: discovery call scheduled; invites sent to Lina/Marco; drafting rollout plan.
Priya C: Status: compliance checklist initialized; BAA request submitted to legal.
Evan (Eng): Status: infra template incoming after CIDR; will assign infra oncall.
Marta (Support): Status: runbook template started; will add monitoring queries when infra confirms metrics.
Alex S: Thanks team :thumbsup:
